name: A320 cabin panel, stiffness-limited, ranked with the end-of-life potential counted (sensitivity only)

reference_mass.source: assumed panel mass; results scale with it

fuel_per_kg_per_flight.source: Steinegger 2017 (ZHAW), Fig. 15, A320-200 marginal fuel at 2000/4000/5000 km; full text read by a sub-agent 2026-11-01; not peer-reviewed

flights.source: A320 original approved validity 48,000 FC; ESA I 60,000 FC (Emerald AEAT 2008, doi 10.1108/aeat.2008.12780caf.005, fetch summary 2026-11-01); low 30,000 = assumption (early retirement)

co2_per_kg_fuel.source: ICAO CEC methodology v8 / UK CORSIA Order 2021 art. 28(5); read 2026-10-25 (aerokit.design.sustainability)

grid_co2_per_MJ.source: OWID/Ember carbon intensity of electricity, CSV read 2026-11-01: EU-27 2024 211.2, France 2024 40.5, China 2024 555.4 g/kWh, divided by 3600

co2_per_kg.source: ICE v2.0 p1 primary Al 12.79 CO2e; EU-made 6.6 (European Aluminium EPR 2024 p5); global 15.1 (IAI factsheet 2022); research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §2

eol_credit_per_kg.source: f_rec x (primary - recycled 1.81 ICE); f_rec 0.85-0.94 (PAMELA, Airbus 2022); own formula; research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §3

2024-T3.properties_source: AA typical via aerospacemetals.com 2023 [S]; metal panels pass the cabin fire tests (non-combustible) [Y]; research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §1b

co2_per_kg.source: Al-Li footprint NOT FOUND; aluminium values used (ICE / EA / IAI)

eol_credit_per_kg.source: f_rec x (primary - recycled 1.81 ICE); f_rec 0.85-0.94 (PAMELA, Airbus 2022); own formula; research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §3

Al-Li 2050-T84.properties_source: Smiths HP distributor sheet 2025 (same E printed for 2198) [S]; research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §1b

co2_per_kg.source: 0.65 x carbon fibre (19.85-33-68) + 0.35 x epoxy 5.70; research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §2

eol_credit_per_kg.source: Granta Eco Design WP p12: continuous-fibre composites 'cannot be re-separated economically' (value 0); Meng 2018 net recycling benefit 19-27 kg CO2e per kg CFRP (abstract) as the high end; research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §3

CFRP QI IM7/8552.properties_source: NCAMP NCP-RP-2009-028 Rev B Tables 5-1/5-2, [25/50/25] RTD [D]; rho 1.57 Hexcel 8552 EU PDS p2 [D]; epoxy panels need FR or phenolic for OSU 65/65 [S]; research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §1a, §4

co2_per_kg.source: GFRP: ICE v2.0 p4 8.10 [D]; Ashby 2013 7.47-8.26 via compilation [S]; research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §2

Glass/phenolic 7781.properties_source: stiffness of 7781 glass on HexPly 913 epoxy as a proxy (phenolic 260 sheet gives fire data only) [D]; HexPly 260/7781 on Nomex OSU 44/44 [D]; research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §1a, §4

co2_per_kg.source: 0.51 x flax 1.70 + 0.49 x epoxy 5.70 (ICE v2.0 p4-5); research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §2

Flax/epoxy.properties_source: QI estimated as 1/3 of the UD FlaxPreg values E1 35 GPa, 365 MPa [Y]; rho 1.3 theoretical [D]; fails OSU peak heat release even with FR (Thulo et al. 2025) [S]; research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §1a, §4

co2_per_kg.source: 0.58 x carbon fibre (19.85-33-68) + 0.42 x PEEK 7.5-13 (weak web value); research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §2

eol_credit_per_kg.source: thermoplastic, remeltable; same range as CFRP, no source for a higher value

CF/PEEK 5HS.properties_source: Toray Cetex TC1200 PDS v4.0 p3 'plain tensile' (lay-up not printed, QI likely) and p2 density [D]; research_notes/Üç sapma alanı/B_malzeme_dongusellik.md §1a

buy_to_fly.source: assumed sheet trim and nesting loss

process_MJ_per_kg.source: rolling 3-5 MJ/kg, Ashby 2013 p. 133 via the compilation
autoclave moulding 100-300 MJ/kg, Ashby 2013 p. 133 via the compilation
compression moulding 11-16 MJ/kg, Ashby 2013 p. 133 via the compilation

exchange_unit: kg CO2 including the end-of-life potential
